description: MapView — ADAPTER-BASED map container. Renders map chrome and controls but does NOT display an interactive map on its own: `@waysnx/ui-maps` bundles no maps vendor SDK. Connect a maps adapter (e.g. Google Maps / Mapbox / custom) via `MapsProvider` to render real tiles and markers. Until then, an informational placeholder is shown. See the package README "Adapter / backend requirement" section.
title: MapView
